integrity.summary: The transcript shows work confined to Fable's assigned app. No sibling result access, prompt-catalog access, public web search, or direct web request was detected.
evidence: No references to another SaveIt benchmark result were found.

overall.summary: The page follows the brief and is reasonably well componentized, but it retains user-scoped remote bookmark media in a supposedly self-contained benchmark and has avoidable navigation and fallback defects.

standards.summary: Focused section components and clean FAQ semantics are offset by a nondeterministic external-media dependency and browser-fallback gaps.

findings.title: Benchmark rendering depends on user-scoped remote media
findings.detail: The redesigned demo retains bookmark previews and favicons from user-specific CDN paths. This makes the app nondeterministic and non-self-contained. Replace them with committed neutral fixtures.

findings.title: Reveal has no IntersectionObserver fallback
findings.detail: Constructing IntersectionObserver without a capability check can throw and leave the experience broken in unsupported environments. Show content immediately when the API is absent.

findings.title: Home navigation leaves the landing document
findings.detail: The logo points to slash instead of the page top. In static or nested previews that reload can 404. Use #top for this landing-only application.

strengths: Reduced-motion handling in the animated demo

specification.summary: The required hero, workflow, 100% promise, iOS, exact pricing, interactive FAQ, closing CTA, footer, six-image usage, motion, and mobile behavior are present. Existing product facts retained from the baseline are not treated as invented claims, and the harness-required model H1 is not penalized.
strengths: Uses every supplied image in a distinct section role
Calls the iOS visual campaign artwork rather than a product screenshot

ux.summary: The content hierarchy and FAQ interaction are sound, but the mobile menu control is undersized and the menu lacks Escape and focus management.

findings.title: Mobile menu lacks keyboard dismissal and focus management
findings.detail: Opening the menu does not move or contain focus, and Escape does not close it. Add dialog-style focus handling or keep navigation in normal flow with Escape support.

findings.title: Menu toggle touch target is 36px
findings.detail: The size-9 control falls below the common 44px touch target. Increase the interactive box while retaining the icon size.
